messages:
Elliot Price: We need to lock where marketplace guidance lives on the docs site. Current situation is scattered (pricing page mentions “buy via marketplace” but no canonical onboarding doc). Qs:
1) Do we create a top-level “Marketplace” section or nest under Billing/Procurement?
2) Separate AWS vs GCP pages?
3) Where does the customer-facing FAQ live vs security FAQ?

Goal: give buyers a single link from AWS/GCP listings + Sales emails + in-console onboarding.

Kira Thompson: +1 to separate AWS vs GCP pages. The steps diverge enough (different purchase flow + org linking edge cases). But we should have one shared “Cloud Marketplaces overview” page so we’re not duplicating the intro + common concepts (entitlements, org linking, billing).

Kira Thompson: Re: nav placement — my vote is under Billing & Procurement (or “Pricing & Billing”), not Getting Started. Most devs won’t start there, but the audience is procurement/IT + platform folks and they’ll look under billing.

Soojin Lee: Please don’t bury it too deep. AWS reviewers keep asking for “deployment instructions” and “support/contact” links, and buyers want a crisp “How to buy + activate” doc. Can we make /docs/marketplace/* as the canonical path and then choose nav placement later?

Talia Benson: From program perspective: we need a stable link we can put into the marketplace listing attachments and into the Console wizard (ENG-4403). If we churn URLs after submission it’ll be a mess.

Chloe Martin: Console onboarding wizard will include a “Read docs” link next to org linking + entitlement status. Ideally it points to a specific anchor like “Link your marketplace purchase to a Redwood org.” If URL is /docs/marketplace/aws that’s fine, we can append #link-your-org.

Elliot Price: Okay, proposing:
- URL namespace: /docs/marketplace/
  - /docs/marketplace/overview
  - /docs/marketplace/aws
  - /docs/marketplace/gcp
  - /docs/marketplace/faq
Then we can put the “Cloud Marketplaces” nav entry under Billing & Procurement but keep the short URLs.

Kira Thompson: Works. On content split:
- overview: concepts + prerequisites + “how it maps to Redwood” (orgs, entitlements, regions)
- aws: purchase flow + activation + common issues
- gcp: same but with GCP-specific validation quirks
- faq: shared Qs (upgrades/downgrades, refunds, support, invoicing, who to contact)

Soojin Lee: For FAQ, can we include a short “Security & compliance” section but keep it high-level and link out to the security FAQ doc? We need to be careful about claims (SOC2 wording, data retention/residency language).

Elliot Price: Yes — we’ll keep security questions lightweight and point to the security packet / security FAQ page that Security signs off on. I’ll avoid hard commitments like “all logs retained X days” unless it’s explicitly configurable.

Markus Klein: From field: buyers always ask “Can I apply my committed spend?” + “How does this map to Dedicated vs Private?” + “Can we do VPC/on-prem via marketplace?”
So the overview page should have a clear “Which SKU should I buy?” section and the FAQ should have a crisp answer for “Can I start Hosted and later move to Dedicated/Private?”

Kira Thompson: + also add “What info do I need to provide to Support to activate faster?” (AWS account ID, GCP billing acct, Redwood org slug, entitlement ID). That will reduce tickets.

Talia Benson: Owners?
We need AWS + GCP pages drafted by end of week so Partnerships can submit links with the listing refresh.

Elliot Price: Proposed owners:
- /docs/marketplace/overview — Elliot (I’ll draft)
- /docs/marketplace/faq — Soojin + Elliot (Soojin for customer-friendly wording, I’ll implement + keep it consistent w/ docs style)
- /docs/marketplace/aws — Kira (with Chloe for org-linking screenshots once DES-212 lands)
- /docs/marketplace/gcp — Elliot (I’ll pull details from the GCP validation notes; may ping Mina if region wording gets tricky)

Soojin Lee: Works. I’ll drop in FAQ blocks from messaging framework and mark anything that needs Security review.

Chloe Martin: FYI screenshots: current Console wizard screens are still in progress. We can provide “temp” images for draft but final needs updated UI states (entitlement pending / linked / error). Please flag in the screenshot inventory so we don’t forget redaction.

Kira Thompson: Noted. For AWS page, I’ll write it to stand without screenshots (step-by-step text + what you should see in Console). Then we can add screenshots as an enhancement.

Elliot Price: Nav placement decision: I’ll add “Cloud Marketplaces” under Billing & Procurement. Also adding a redirect from /docs/marketplace -> /docs/marketplace/overview.

Talia Benson: +1. Please also add cross-links:
- pricing page -> marketplace overview
- getting started -> “Buying via marketplace? see here” (small callout)
- support/troubleshooting page -> marketplace FAQ

Elliot Price: Action items:
- Elliot: create docs stub pages + nav + redirect today
- Kira: AWS content draft by Thu EOD
- Elliot: GCP content draft by Thu EOD
- Soojin: FAQ wording + security section by Fri noon
Then we route security-related FAQ lines to Marcus/Aisha for quick sanity check.

Soojin Lee: :thumbsup: I’ll keep a “Do/Don’t” note in the doc comments so folks don’t add new security claims ad hoc.

Markus Klein: Thanks. When you have a stable URL, send it my way — I’ll update the SE talk track to point prospects there.
